---
title: Loading a CEX corpus
---

CEX files are `urn|text` lines, one per citable passage. `read_cex` can filter by a substring of the URN to preselect particular works.

```python
from udsyntax import read_cex

lines = read_cex("genesis.cex", urn_filter="vulgate")
urns = [urn for urn, _ in lines]
texts = [text for _, text in lines]
```
